usage: tr guards [-h] [--rule ID] [--run RUN_ID] [--last N] {scan} ...

read <data_dir>/audit.jsonl (GUARDS-SPIKE §3.3): the last guard decisions,
then counts by stage, rule and decision; an empty or missing log prints the
header

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
  --rule ID     only this rule's decisions (e.g. stop_floor, one_live)
  --run RUN_ID  only this run's decisions
  --last N      show the last N decisions (default 20)

subcommands:
  {scan}
    scan        search a directory for keys and tokens, read only (exit 1 on a
                hit)
